title.instruction: Write a fun, simple, and playful title for a children's story based on this summary: {educational_summary_input}. Keep it short and exciting.

premise.instruction: Write a one-paragraph story premise suitable for kids. Describe the world, the main character, and the adventure. Use simple words, short sentences, and fun imagery. Educational summary: {educational_summary_input}. Do NOT include the word 'Title' or any headings.
